normalized.result: Honestly the ideal for me is a blend of the two: I type, and as I type it offers the tags I've already used so I can pick one. So between these two, typing with suggestions fits me best — picking from a list alone is fine when I remember the exact tag, but I don't want to lose the ability to just type a brand-new one. Either mechanism is acceptable, but if you're combining them, lead with typing and surface the existing matches as I go. No need for more variations.
